signal_pattern: Left-side Battery LED blinking amber rapidly (AC disconnected)
indicated_condition: Battery has reached critical low charge level or battery cell imbalance detected
recommended_action: Connect 65W USB-C AC adapter (L04650-850) immediately; run HP PC Hardware Diagnostics UEFI Battery Test (F2).

signal_pattern: Caps Lock LED blinks 2 long, 2 short flashes (BIOS Corruption)
indicated_condition: Main System BIOS image in 9MB SPI flash is corrupted or interrupted during flash update
recommended_action: Wait for HP Sure Start automatic recovery from 8MB backup flash, or hold Win+B + Power for 3 seconds.

signal_pattern: Caps Lock LED blinks 3 long, 2 short flashes (Memory Initialization Failure)
indicated_condition: Onboard soldered LPDDR5-6400 memory initialization failed during POST
recommended_action: Perform 30-second RTC/Hard Reset. Because LPDDR5 RAM is soldered, persistent 3.2 blink requires System Board replacement.

signal_pattern: Caps Lock LED blinks 5 long, 2 short flashes (Embedded Controller Error)
indicated_condition: Embedded Controller (EC) cannot communicate with Display Hub/EC board or mainboard power rails
recommended_action: Check Transfer Board (N22942-001) and Display Cable Kit (N22930-001) ZIF connections; run HP Sure Start recovery.

signal_pattern: 24-Digit Hardware Failure ID generated during UEFI Storage Short/Long DST Test (F2)
indicated_condition: M.2 2280 PCIe NVMe SSD read/write sector failure or SMART threshold exceeded
recommended_action: Record 24-digit Failure ID for HP EAS warranty claim and replace M.2 2280 NVMe SSD (e.g., M52027-005 / M16560-005).

signal_pattern: 24-Digit Hardware Failure ID on UEFI Battery Check (Weak / Replace / Very Low Capacity)
indicated_condition: 4-cell 53 Whr (Folio G3) or 68 Whr (G3) battery capacity degraded below threshold or cell fault
recommended_action: Replace battery (M90788-005) and ensure top and bottom battery insulators are installed per p.44.

signal_pattern: POST Boot Halt: 'Unauthorized Wireless Module Detected - System Halted (Error 702/704)'
indicated_condition: Non-HP whitelisted WWAN module installed in M.2 socket
recommended_action: Remove unauthorized module and install only HP regulatory-approved WWAN spare part (N00181-005 5G or N00182-005 LTE).

signal_pattern: Electrostatic discharge >= 700 V (e.g., 7,500V-35,000V walking across carpet at 10-55% RH)
indicated_condition: Latent silicon junction degradation on System Board, SSD, or Camera Module
recommended_action: Always use 1 MOhm +-10% grounded wrist strap and static-dissipative mat (Metallized laminate shields up to 15,000V).
